notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least one indestructible counter on it.
description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{U}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Biovisionary spell three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.
